pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions on the flank display a sub-polygonal morphology with rounded vertices and soft pixel gradients at the edges. Patch size is variable, appearing smaller and more densely packed on the lower flank and proximal limb compared to the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light pelage separates the patches, characterized by narrow pathways and frequent tri-radial junction nodes. The pixel thickness of these corridors is relatively uniform across the visible flank, maintaining topological continuity without significant broadening.
